ideas.name: Glow Memory
ideas.approachWhy: The path itself is best made by a seeded generator, so the course changes between runs and players can't just learn one answer. The ways the path is shown (all at once, one by one, as notes, on a map board, pink traps) are hand-made modes on top of it; the variants below are those modes, each with one example path.

have: "glow" tile look and the GlowTrail builder (tiles in lanes, moves like "frfl")
"flip" motion: on/off by server time with period, duty and phase (good for a glow that replays)
"melt" motion: the tile the local player stands on fades and drops after `delay` (use for fake tiles with a short delay and a long away)
Seeded random (Rng) and per-client building, so a seeded path is the same for everyone in a round
Falls already send you back to the start pad

new.what: Light pulse (same piece as Lights Out, idea 17): glow goes on and off by server time but the tile always stays solid (flip today also turns off collision)
Fake tile: the melt kind with a 0.2 s delay, reusing Melting Floor's (idea 2) melt warning look and crack sound squeezed into that 0.2 s; looks exactly like a safe tile until you land
Glow Path generator in ObbyCourse: seed -> one safe tile per row, lane change at most 1 per row, plus Lune specs (same pure-Luau + spec pattern as Melt Grid, Arrow Maze and Clue Doors generators)
Chime per glowing tile and note-per-lane sound, played in time through Beat Pads' (idea 18) client beat clock (Chime Path, Song Path)

Client step trigger: standing on a pad starts something for the local player only (Show Me Pad, Map Behind You); same per-player trigger as Rising Goo's Head Start Gate and Sliding Maze's chaser wall, build it once
Map board: Clue Doors' (idea 29) clue board look, with lit cells made of small Neon parts (no SurfaceGui, so no world-label row needed)
New Every Round: the client re-rolls the path from (seed, round number) and swaps which tiles are fake at the round change; the tile you stand on never drops

ideas.readability: A sign on the entry pad: "Remember the glowing path". Safe tiles glow green and chime while shown; then every tile is the same plain slab. A fake tile wobbles and cracks for a moment before it drops, so the player knows it was a wrong tile, not a bug. Unlike Lights Out (idea 17), where the glow guides you while you walk, here the glow is gone by the time you step on, so it reads as a test, not a guide.

generator.inputs: seed (course seed + section index), rows (4 to 8), lanes (2 or 3), safe tiles per row (1 or 2), show mode (all at once, one by one, notes, map board, pink traps), glow time, replay time.
generator.randomises: Which tile is safe in each row (the path), and for 2-safe rows which one is fake. In New Every Round, it rolls a new path each round from (seed, round).
generator.guarantees: Exactly one safe tile per row (or two on easy), and the next safe tile is in the same lane or the lane next to it, so every jump is a 3 to 4 stud hop (test limit 6) on the flat or at most 2.5 studs up. Tiles 8 x 8, three lanes fill the 24 stud lane. The entry pad is always solid, so you can wait there for the glow to replay. The glow lasts at least 0.3 s per row and never less than 1.5 s. No more than 3 rows in a row in the same lane on medium and hard, so it is not just a straight line. The tile you stand on never drops in a round change. Under 80 parts: 8 rows x 3 lanes = 24 tiles plus pads and sign.
generator.difficulty: Easy: 4 to 5 rows, 2 lanes or 2 safe per row, glow 4 s, replay every 8 s, some tiles stay lit. Medium: 6 rows x 3 lanes, glow 3 s, lane changes forced, one-by-one or note modes, show-on-button. Hard: 8 rows or two grids, glow under 2 s or one tile at a time, path that changes each round.

variants.name: First Steps
variants.does: Two wide lanes and only four rows: the whole path glows at once and the glow comes back every few seconds.
variants.numbers: 4 rows x 2 lanes, tiles 8x8, 3 stud hop between rows, glows 4 s, replays every 8 s

variants.name: Two of Three
variants.does: Each row has two safe tiles and one fake, so you only have to remember which tile to skip.
variants.numbers: 5 rows x 3 lanes, 2 safe per row, glows 4 s, replays every 8 s

variants.name: Breadcrumbs
variants.does: Every other safe tile keeps a faint glow, so you only remember the rows in between.
variants.numbers: 6 rows x 3 lanes, rows 1, 3, 5 stay lit, glows 4 s, replays every 9 s

variants.name: Chime Path
variants.does: The safe tiles light up one by one from front to back, each with a rising chime, so you hear the order as well as see it.
variants.numbers: 5 rows x 3 lanes, 0.7 s per tile, whole path then stays lit 2 s, replays every 9 s

variants.name: Show Me Pad
variants.does: The path only glows when you stand on the start pad's button; step back onto it whenever you want another look.
variants.numbers: 6 rows x 3 lanes, button on the entry pad, glows 3 s per press, 2 s cooldown

variants.name: Snake Trail
variants.does: The path changes lane on every row, so you cannot just run straight once you have the first tile.
variants.numbers: 6 rows x 3 lanes, lane change every row, glows 3 s, replays every 10 s

variants.name: Pink Traps
variants.does: The other way round: the fake tiles glow pink, then fade, and you must remember where not to step.
variants.numbers: 6 rows x 3 lanes, 1 fake per row, fakes glow pink 3 s, replays every 10 s

variants.name: Memory Stairs
variants.does: Each row is a step higher, so you see the whole pattern from the bottom but lose sight of it as you climb.
variants.numbers: 5 rows x 3 lanes, each row 2.5 studs higher, 3 stud hop, glows 3 s, replays every 10 s

variants.name: Song Path
variants.does: The path plays as notes: a low note means left, middle means centre, high means right, while the tiles glow only briefly.
variants.numbers: 5 rows x 3 lanes, 1 note per row (0.6 s apart), glow 1.5 s, replays every 9 s

variants.name: Map Behind You
variants.does: The floor never glows: a lit map board stands on the entry pad facing back the way you came, so you read it, turn round, and walk the grid from memory.
variants.numbers: 6 rows x 3 lanes, board 6x3 cells on the entry pad facing backwards, lights while you stand on the pad, nothing glows on the floor

variants.name: Quick Flash
variants.does: A long grid and only a short flash of the whole path, so you have to take it in at a glance.
variants.numbers: 8 rows x 3 lanes, glows 1.8 s, replays every 12 s, 3.5 stud hops

variants.name: Two Grids, One Look
variants.does: Two grids with a safe pad between them, but both paths only show while you are on the first pad.
variants.numbers: 2 x 4 rows x 3 lanes, middle pad 8 studs, both glow 4 s, replays every 12 s

variants.name: New Every Round
variants.does: The safe path changes every round, and a new round can start while you are on the grid, so you read the new glow mid-run.
variants.numbers: 6 rows x 3 lanes, round every 10 s, glows 2.5 s at round start, a 1 s tick before the change

variants.name: Trail Run
variants.does: One tile lights at a time, moving ahead of you, and the light does not wait: you remember the trail behind the light.
variants.numbers: 8 rows x 3 lanes, 0.5 s per tile, no full-path glow, replays every 8 s

variants.name: Hot Feet
variants.does: The safe tiles also melt 1.5 s after you land, so you can't stop on the grid to think: you must know the whole path before you leave the pad.
variants.numbers: 6 rows x 3 lanes, safe tiles melt 1.5 s after landing (back when you restart), fakes drop at 0.2 s, glows 3 s, replays every 10 s
